references.text: Simeon was born as Jacob's second son with Leah. His name and lineage are mentioned here as the origin of the tribe of Simeon.
The sons of Simeon who went down to Egypt with Jacob, becoming the ancestors of the clans now counted.
The sons of Simeon and their clans are listed, showing the family lines that form the basis for this count.
The next verse gives the result of the counting of the tribe of Simeon: 59,300 men.
The tribe of Simeon receives its place in the camp beside Reuben on the south side of the tabernacle.
The second census of the tribe of Simeon, showing a significant decline to 22,200 men.
The tribe of Simeon receives its inheritance within the territory of Judah in the promised land.
The genealogy of the tribe of Simeon in Chronicles, showing the further history of the tribe.
